associations.rationale: Representation directly defines the representation type from an algebra and an additive group, with the module formulation supplied by the project definition.
ofAlgHom directly turns a unital algebra homomorphism into End(V) into a left A-module structure.
The round-trip equality directly establishes the equivalence from a module to its endomorphism homomorphism and back.
toAlgHom directly sends a left A-module structure to a unital algebra homomorphism A → End(V).
The round-trip equality directly establishes the converse from an endomorphism-valued homomorphism to a module and back.
